# Customer success, support and community

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py. Edit the YAML source, not this file. -->

**Department id:** `customer-success`  
**Mission:** Get customers to value quickly, resolve issues honestly and feed real problems back to the product.

## Startup stage

Founders answer support personally; the issue taxonomy and feedback-to-roadmap process start on day one so the signal is not lost.

## Agents operating in this department

`customer-success-specialist`, `growth-lead`
